headline: ArcBest Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y on Pricing Gains
summary: ARCB's Q2 adjusted earnings jump 75% as revenues rise 15.9%, powered by stronger segment performance, pricing and network efficiency.
